subjects: price-based vs quantity-based financial-conditions index tightening/support
cross-asset market liquidity deterioration and investor long positioning (belongs under the separate market liquidity / cross asset positioning labels)
mis_merges.why: The two stray liquidity/positioning cards dilute the FCI theme with redundant content that already has a proper home elsewhere, but an editor would still correctly select 'financial conditions tightening on higher yields' as the theme either way.

notes: Fragmentation, not mis-merging, is the dominant defect: 23 subjects are split across 2-11 labels apiece (322/942 cards, 34%), well above the 10% gate. Several are literal duplicate-name labels (cyclical longs/cyclicals longs, us labour market/us labor market, oil price/oil prices, asset allocation/cross asset allocation, emerging markets hedges/em hedges), pointing to a labeling-consistency bug rather than genuine topical distinctions.
